units.mnist-add2: 100 ordered addition facts (a,b) in Z_10 x Z_10
units.hwf: 36 operator-application cells (op, right operand digit 1..9); eval-only extension

notes: Stage single varies one factor at a time against the clean condition; stage combined is the 3x3x3 factorial of moderate-to-severe levels.
MNIST budget 1.0/100 checks is the exhaustive candidate set; lower levels truncate it.
Knowledge masking is nested by a stable hash ordering, so level 0.1 is a subset of 0.2.
The frozen v10 full checkpoint is never retrained or fine-tuned by this protocol.
